custom_css: .grid--uniform {/* Equal-height cards and aligned buttons */ display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; justify-content: center;}
.collection-filter .grid__item {/* Centre filter in a full-width column */ width: 100%; text-align: center;}

settings.code:
<style>
/* Collection spacing, typography and centred filters */
#CollectionSection{--gap:34px;--top:20px;--title:.765}
#CollectionSection .section-header{padding-top:var(--top);margin-bottom:30px;text-align:center}
#CollectionSection .collection-title{font-size:calc(var(--typeHeaderSize)*var(--title))}
#CollectionSection .collection-description{max-width:920px;margin:auto;text-align:center}
#CollectionSection .enlarge-text,#CollectionSection .enlarge-text p{font-size:inherit}
#CollectionSection .collection-description+hr{height:0;margin:var(--gap) 0 0}
#CollectionSection .collection-filter{margin:0}
#CollectionSection .collection-filter .grid__item{width:100%;text-align:center}
#CollectionSection .collection-filter :is(.btn,select){width:auto;margin-bottom:30px}
@media(min-width:590px){
#CollectionSection{--gap:100px;--top:40px;--title:.9}
}
</style>
